data.name: Private Snorkel Adventure
data.headline: A dedicated reef day on the 30' Jeanneau yacht
data.description:
A four-hour private snorkel charter to the Atlantic patch reefs 6–10 miles offshore from Key West — sergeant majors, parrotfish, the occasional southern stingray, and seasonally, green sea turtles. Quality masks, fins, and snorkels for up to 6 guests come with the boat, plus floats and a Lily Pad for between-reef breaks. Your USCG-licensed captain adjusts the route on the day based on swell and visibility — there’s no “scheduled” reef.

Quick facts: 

• 4 hrs $1,195 
• Private 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• Perry Hotel & Marina 
• All snorkel gear, fuel + safety gear included

data.itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet your Six Fins captain at Dock A, Slip #32. After a safety briefing and snorkel gear fitting, we cruise offshore toward the Florida Keys Reef Tract — North America’s only living barrier reef.

Scenic Offshore Cruise
Relax during the ride as we head to the reef, enjoying open-water views and watching for dolphins, sea birds, and flying fish along the way.

Primary Reef Snorkel Stop
Anchor over a carefully selected reef location chosen based on water clarity, wind, and sea conditions. After instruction and assistance, enter the water to explore vibrant coral formations, tropical fish, rays, and other marine life.

Surface Interval & Relaxation
Return onboard to hydrate, enjoy light refreshments, and relax between snorkel sessions.

Optional Second Reef Location (Conditions Permitting)
Time and conditions permitting, your captain may reposition to a second reef site for a different underwater perspective.

Return Cruise
Enjoy a relaxing ride back to the marina with unforgettable memories of your underwater adventure.

data.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT ACTION REQUIRED
Six Fins Charter – Reef Snorkel Charter Confirmation

Dear Guests,

We’re excited to welcome you aboard your Private Reef Snorkel Charter — a 4-hour adventure to the world-famous Key West coral reef.

Please review the important details below to ensure a smooth and unforgettable experience.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

✅ Before Your Trip

For trips up to six passengers:

👉 Each passenger must complete the insurance waiver (including adults on behalf of minors): [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/rd9k5tiavpwper7h2rhaqh/web/)

AND for trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

👉 The primary renter (21+ years old) and captain must complete the Bareboat Agreement together at the dock before departure, but prior to arrival, you may begin: [here](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/ez5636zbxexwrng7dtz6mq/web/)

Please complete all forms prior to arrival so we can depart on time.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🌊 Your Reef Snorkel Experience

This is a private 4-hour offshore snorkeling charter to the Florida Keys Reef Tract — North America’s only living barrier reef.

Possible reef locations include:

• Western Sambo Reef
• Eastern Dry Rocks (near the Christ of the Abyss statue)
• Sand Key Reef
• Rock Key
• Cottrell Key patch reefs

Your captain selects the optimal location based on weather, visibility, and sea conditions.

After a safety and snorkel orientation, you’ll explore vibrant coral formations, tropical fish, rays, and other marine life in crystal-clear waters — without the crowds of large tour boats.

Snorkeling is optional. Guests may relax onboard at any time.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🛥 Departure Details

Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd
Stock Island, FL 33040

Free parking is available adjacent to The Perry Hotel & Marina.
Please arrive 15 minutes before departure.

🩺 Health & Safety

Your safety is our highest priority.

• Operated by U.S. Coast Guard–licensed captains
• Safety briefing and snorkel orientation provided
• Life jackets available for all guests
• Snorkel sites selected based on current conditions
• Food allergies or dietary restrictions: reply to this email and let us know in advance so we can prepare.
• Prone to seasickness: tell us ahead of time and we'll suggest what to take before boarding.

Snorkeling is an open-water activity. Guests should be comfortable swimming in ocean conditions, including potential currents and waves.

Not recommended for guests who are pregnant or those with serious heart, respiratory, neck/back, or recent surgical conditions.

Excessive intoxication or unsafe behavior may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.

data.special_requirements:
• Children under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
• The primary booking party must be at least 21 years old.
• Guests must be comfortable in open-water environments.
• Basic swimming ability is required for anyone entering the water.
• Non-swimmers may remain onboard but should notify the captain in advance.
• Infants and toddlers must have a properly fitting U.S. Coast Guard–approved life jacket (guests must provide infant/toddler sizes).
• All participants must follow captain instructions at all times.
data.restrictions:
This experience may not be suitable for everyone.

• Not recommended for guests with serious heart conditions, respiratory conditions, seizure disorders, recent surgeries, neck/back injuries, or significant mobility limitations.
• Guests must be physically able to climb a swim ladder and reboard the vessel independently or with minimal assistance.
• Wheelchair access is limited due to vessel design and offshore conditions.
• Excessive intoxication will result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.
• Smoking or vaping is not permitted inside the cabin.

If you have medical concerns, please consult your physician prior to booking.

data.health_and_safety_notes:
Your safety is our highest priority.

• Operated by experienced, U.S. Coast Guard–licensed captains
• Safety briefing and snorkel orientation provided before entering the water
• U.S. Coast Guard–approved life jackets available for all guests
• Required safety equipment onboard at all times
• Snorkeling locations selected based on weather, visibility, and sea conditions
• Captains monitor guests while in the water

Snorkeling is an open-water activity. Conditions may include currents, waves, and changing visibility. Guests should be in good physical health and comfortable swimming in the ocean.

Captains reserve the right to modify or cancel snorkeling activities if conditions are unsafe.

Food allergies and dietary restrictions: Please inform us in advance if you or anyone in your party has a food allergy or dietary restriction, so we can prepare accordingly. Reply to your confirmation email or call us.

Prone to seasickness: Let us know in advance and we can suggest what to take before you board.
